Lily hopes to visit Toronto one day. Both of them like soup and coffee. Lily likes rainy days best. Airport transfer is included in the price.

It takes twenty minutes to get to the night market by bike. They took many photos at the train station. There are always many people at the train station. Best of all, a return ticket saves a few pounds.
Lily borrowed a book about music from the gym. Lily thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Lily learned a lot about music. Also, the layover in Oslo lasts six hours.
Lily wants to be a cook in the future. The night market is one of the best places in the city. Last Sunday, Lily and Jack went to the night market.
